project.name: Observatory
project.summary: A local-first fantasy map builder that people and browser agents can edit together through WebMCP.
project.ai_usage: WebMCP lets browser agents inspect and edit the same semantic local map as the human editor; OpenAI image generation produced bundled map artwork.
project.codex_usage: Codex supported implementation, debugging, refactoring, testing, documentation, and repository-readiness review.
